title: Forge effect boundary v1 (an additive payload extension at event_schema 1)
description: The optional, absent-by-default payload field decision 0046 ruling 3 adds to effect/started: which boundary stood at every invocation site of the attempt. Legal at event_schema 1 under the amended rule in contracts/README.md: optional, absent by default, published here as a numbered extension schema, and never read by fold — RunState gains nothing from it, and a run over a bundle that boxes nothing journals byte-identical payloads. This is a narrowed reading of ruling 3's 'every effect/started', named as such: a field on every start would be a v2 event, which the closed type enum forbids; ruling 3's 'every' is carried by the seat record instead (seat-record.v4). The data carries the plain word; every readout renders the adjective unboxed for a run in which any gate-class site stood under harness or open.

boundary.description: Present on effect/started ONLY when at least one invocation site of this attempt declares hands. A LIST keyed by invocation site with the same member tags effect-provenance.v1 uses, built from the same traversal, one entry per site of the attempt whether or not that site has hands.

member.description: The invocation-site tag the engine already uses for checkpoints and provenance: null for a single seat, '<member>' for a panel member, '<step>' for a sequence step, '<step>:<member>' for a member inside a step panel.

boundary.description: The realm's word for a site with hands (decision 0046 ruling 1); decision 0031's sentinel for a site without.

gate.description: Whether the site is gate class (decision 0021), read where the compiler keeps it. A run is rendered unboxed exactly when an entry has gate true and a word of harness or open.
